Sam (Sales): Hey team — ACME security just sent over a checklist. they want: DFD, full subprocessor list, and confirmation that customer data will stay in eu-west-1 for the POC. can we provide all that and an ETA?

Nina (Solutions): We can. do they want diagrams for hosted API only, or also Dedicated/Private deployment options? POC ask usually prefers Dedicated for region pinning.

Sam (Sales): They explicitly said 'no data leaves EU' for POC. also asked for answers to a handful of SIG/CAIQ items related to key management and dataflow.

Liam (SecOps): Quick notes: we can provide a completed CAIQ export (redacted for internal subprocessors) and a subprocessor disclosure doc. for true 'no cross-region' guarantee we need Dedicated or Private with region pinning and telemetry/privacy flags enabled. hosted (multi-region) will not satisfy that.

Josh (Platform Eng): Confirming technical constraints: hosted endpoints may route metadata/telemetry to central control plane in us-east for analytics unless privacy_mode=true and region_lock enabled. Dedicated eu-west-1 deployment => no cross-region KV replication by default.

Nina (Solutions): For the DFD, I'll produce two versions: 1) Hosted (what we typically ship) with telemetry notes, 2) Dedicated/Private (eu-west-1 only) DFD that shows VPC peering and optional on-prem connector. ETA ~ 24 hours.

Sam (Sales): Nice. can you include explicit KMS/HSM callouts (who holds keys, customer-managed KMS option)? they also want retention windows and where logs land.

Liam (SecOps): We'll state options clearly: - Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS (keys in a region we control) or customer can bring-your-own KMS via KMS integration (supported for Dedicated/Private). - HSM integrations: supported via partner HSM for Private deployments only. - Audit logs: If Dedicated/Private + region_lock, audit logs can be stored in customer S3 in eu-west-1 or forwarded to their SIEM.

Josh (Platform Eng): Paste of suggested deployment config snippet for POC (redact before sending):
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  region: eu-west-1
  region_lock: true
  privacy_mode: true
  kms: customer-managed
  data_retention_days: 30
```

Nina (Solutions): I'll include that snippet in the DFD doc and an annotated diagram. sample ASCII DFD we can expand: 

[User (EU)] -> [Customer App in eu-west-1] -> [Redwood Dedicated Inference (eu-west-1)]
                                |-> [KV Cache (encrypted, eu-west-1)]
                                |-> [Customer KMS (eu-west-1) - optional]
                                |-> [Audit logs -> Customer S3 (eu-west-1) or SIEM]

Sam (Sales): Also they asked about subprocessors list for vendor risk. are we allowed to share full vendor list or a redacted list? they want names + country + purpose.

Liam (SecOps): We can share our official Subprocessor Disclosure CSV (redacted where contracts require it). will include: name, country, service category (e.g., cloud infra, monitoring, observability, payments), and whether data access is possible. I'll attach the internal export to the thread.

svc-oncall-bot: CAIQ export uploaded to secure drive: https://redwood.internal/secure/caqi_exports/1768423456/ (access: security-team + solutions).

Nina (Solutions): For SIG/CAIQ answers: we have a templated export for most enterprise requests. I'll mark items that require legal approval (e.g., subprocessor contract redactions). ETA for full package (DFD, subprocessor CSV, CAIQ): EOD tomorrow if nothing blocks.

Sam (Sales): Great. last two asks from ACME: 1) pricing delta for a 2-week Dedicated POC, 2) whether we can sign an addendum to restrict data to eu-west-1 for the POC.

Josh (Platform Eng): Pricing: rough POC estimate depends on capacity — for a small Dedicated POC (single GPU pool, limited TPS) expect ~€6k-€9k for a 2-week reserved window (includes setup). I'll follow up with exact pricelist.

Liam (SecOps): Legal needs to approve data residency addendum but Security will sign off technically. addendum is standard for short-term POCs — ask legal to expedite.

Nina (Solutions): I'll assemble: - DFD (hosted + dedicated) - Annotated config snippet - Subprocessor disclosure (CSV) - CAIQ export - Short note on keys/audit/retention - POC infra checklist and estimated pricing

Sam (Sales): Perfect. ACME also wants a one-page 'what we control vs what they control' table for the security review. can you add that?

Nina (Solutions): Yep. I'll include a 1-pager (Control matrix). sample items: network isolation, key custody, log ownership, support access.

Sam (Sales): ETA summary for customer: DFD + CAIQ + subproc CSV + control matrix + pricing estimate by tomorrow EOD. Thanks all — please ping here when docs uploaded. :thumbsup:

svc-oncall-bot: File created: /secure/caqi_exports/1768423456/CAIQ_ACME_redacted.pdf

Liam (SecOps): Uploaded subprocessor export to secure drive: https://redwood.internal/secure/subprocessors/exports/1768423456/subprocessors_redacted.csv

Nina (Solutions): Uploaded DFD + matrix draft: https://redwood.internal/secure/diagrams/1768423456/acme-dfd-dedicated.pdf (please review)

Sam (Sales): Reviewing now. will forward to ACME sec team after legal gives go. thanks everyone.
